title.zh: 視距無線電鏈路：頻率與通聯可達率
title.en: Line-of-Sight Radio Links: Frequency & Link Availability

voice.style: 熱情的科技講解語氣，台灣華語，抑揚頓挫明顯
voice.styleEn: Energetic tech-explainer tone in Taiwanese Mandarin, lively intonation

sentences.zh: 同樣的電台、同樣的功率，換一個頻段，通聯結果可能完全不同。
sentences.en: Same radio, same power — switch bands, and the link can behave completely differently.

sentences.zh: 這支影片比較兩個頻段：低頻段 1350 到 2690 MHz，高頻段 4400 到 5900 MHz。
sentences.en: We compare two bands: the low band, 1350 to 2690 MHz, and the high band, 4400 to 5900 MHz.
sentences.tts: 這支影片比較兩個頻段：低頻段一千三百五十到兩千六百九十 MHz，高頻段四千四百到五千九百 MHz。

sentences.zh: 我們從四個物理面向來看：距離損耗、菲涅爾區淨空、多路徑反射，以及植被與天氣。
sentences.en: We look at four physical factors: distance loss, Fresnel zone clearance, multipath reflections, and foliage and weather.

sentences.zh: 最後，再把這些原理套進城市、森林、水面和山區等實際情境。
sentences.en: Then we apply them to real terrain: cities, forests, water and mountains.

sentences.zh: 視距鏈路最基本的衰減，叫做自由空間路徑損耗，簡稱 FSPL。
sentences.en: The most basic loss on a line-of-sight link is free-space path loss, or FSPL.

sentences.zh: 公式是：32.4，加上 20 log 頻率 MHz，再加上 20 log 距離公里。
sentences.en: FSPL in dB is 32.4, plus 20 log of the frequency in MHz, plus 20 log of the distance in km.
sentences.tts: 公式是：三十二點四，加上二十 log 頻率，再加上二十 log 距離；頻率用 MHz，距離用公里。

sentences.zh: 記住兩個口訣：距離加倍，損耗多 6 dB；頻率加倍，損耗同樣多 6 dB。
sentences.en: Two rules of thumb: double the distance, add 6 dB; double the frequency, add another 6 dB.
sentences.tts: 記住兩個口訣：距離加倍，損耗多六 dB；頻率加倍，損耗同樣多六 dB。

sentences.zh: 以 20 公里為例，1350 MHz 損耗約 121 dB，5900 MHz 約 134 dB，差了將近 13 dB。
sentences.en: At 20 km, the loss is about 121 dB at 1350 MHz and about 134 dB at 5900 MHz — nearly 13 dB apart.
sentences.tts: 以二十公里為例，一千三百五十 MHz 損耗約一百二十一 dB，五千九百 MHz 約一百三十四 dB，差了將近十三 dB。

sentences.zh: 用 0.3 瓦、也就是 24.8 dBm 發射，兩端都是 0 dBi 天線，20 公里外，低頻約收到負 96 dBm，高頻只剩負 109 dBm。
sentences.en: Transmitting 0.3 W, or 24.8 dBm, with 0 dBi antennas, at 20 km you receive about −96 dBm on the low band but only −109 dBm on the high band.
sentences.tts: 用零點三瓦、也就是二十四點八 dBm 發射，兩端都是零 dBi 天線，二十公里外，低頻約收到負九十六 dBm，高頻只剩負一百零九 dBm。

sentences.zh: 這些是套公式的示範數字，實際還要看天線增益、饋線損耗和接收靈敏度。
sentences.en: These are illustrative numbers; real links also depend on antenna gain, feeder loss and receiver sensitivity.

chapters.en: Where the Frequency Term Comes From

sentences.zh: 不過要澄清一個常見誤解：電波在空間中擴散，本身跟頻率無關。
sentences.en: But let's clear up a common misconception: the way energy spreads through space doesn't depend on frequency.

sentences.zh: 公式裡會出現頻率，是因為它假設兩端都用等向天線。
sentences.en: The frequency term appears because the formula assumes isotropic antennas at both ends.

sentences.zh: 等向天線的有效孔徑跟波長平方成正比，頻率越高，能接住的能量越少。
sentences.en: An isotropic antenna's effective aperture scales with wavelength squared, so the higher the frequency, the less energy it catches.

sentences.zh: 反過來說，同樣大小的天線，在高頻反而有更高的增益。
sentences.en: Flip it around: an antenna of the same physical size has more gain at a higher frequency.

sentences.zh: 所以用高增益天線補償後，高頻的實際鏈路餘裕差距，會比公式看起來小。
sentences.en: So with high-gain antennas, the real link-margin gap for the high band is smaller than the formula suggests.

sentences.zh: 看得到對方，不代表鏈路就一定好。
sentences.en: Seeing the far end doesn't guarantee a good link.

sentences.zh: 電波會在直線路徑周圍，形成一個橄欖球形的菲涅爾區。
sentences.en: Radio energy travels through a football-shaped Fresnel zone around the straight path.

sentences.zh: 地形、樹木或建物一旦侵入這個區域，就會產生繞射損耗。
sentences.en: When terrain, trees or buildings intrude into it, you get diffraction loss.

sentences.zh: 第一菲涅爾區半徑，等於 17.3 乘上根號，d1 乘 d2，除以頻率 GHz 乘總距離。
sentences.en: The first Fresnel radius is 17.3 times the square root of d1 times d2, over the frequency in GHz times the total distance.
sentences.tts: 第一菲涅爾區半徑，等於十七點三乘上根號：d1 乘 d2，除以頻率 GHz 乘總距離。

sentences.zh: 在 20 公里鏈路的正中央，1350 MHz 半徑約 33 公尺，5900 MHz 只有約 16 公尺。
sentences.en: At the midpoint of a 20 km link, the radius is about 33 m at 1350 MHz, but only about 16 m at 5900 MHz.
sentences.tts: 在二十公里鏈路的正中央，一千三百五十 MHz 半徑約三十三公尺，五千九百 MHz 只有約十六公尺。

sentences.zh: ITU-R P.530 建議，路徑至少要淨空第一菲涅爾區的 60%。
sentences.en: ITU-R P.530 recommends clearing at least 60% of the first Fresnel zone.
sentences.tts: ITU-R P 五三零建議，路徑至少要淨空第一菲涅爾區的百分之六十。

sentences.zh: 換算下來，中點淨空低頻段要約 20 公尺，高頻段約 9.6 公尺。
sentences.en: That's about 20 m of midpoint clearance for the low band, and about 9.6 m for the high band.
sentences.tts: 換算下來，中點淨空低頻段要約二十公尺，高頻段約九點六公尺。

sentences.zh: 如果障礙物剛好貼著視線，視形狀而定，損耗可能高達 15 dB。
sentences.en: If an obstacle just grazes the line of sight, the loss can reach 15 dB, depending on its shape.
sentences.tts: 如果障礙物剛好貼著視線，視形狀而定，損耗可能高達十五 dB。

sentences.zh: 實務上有個更快的判斷法：只看路徑正中央，這個最嚴苛的位置。
sentences.en: In practice there's a quicker check: look only at the midpoint, the tightest spot on the path.

sentences.zh: 中點的 0.6 F1 淨空，約等於 5.2 乘上根號，距離公里除以頻率 GHz，單位是公尺。
sentences.en: The midpoint 0.6 F1 clearance is about 5.2 times the square root of distance in km over frequency in GHz, in meters.
sentences.tts: 中點的零點六 F1 淨空，約等於五點二乘上根號：距離公里除以頻率 GHz，單位是公尺。

sentences.zh: 以 4700 MHz 為例：1.2 公里只要 2.6 公尺，10 公里要 7.6 公尺，30 公里要 13.1 公尺。
sentences.en: At 4700 MHz: 2.6 m for 1.2 km, 7.6 m for 10 km, and 13.1 m for 30 km.
sentences.tts: 以四千七百 MHz 為例：一點二公里只要二點六公尺，十公里要七點六公尺，三十公里要十三點一公尺。

sentences.zh: 路徑中點附近的建物或樹木低於這個高度，就不必擔心。
sentences.en: If buildings or trees near the midpoint stay below that height, you're fine.

sentences.zh: 但 0.6 F1 是零損耗的保守門檻，還可以用鏈路餘裕反推。
sentences.en: But 0.6 F1 is a conservative, zero-loss threshold — you can also work backward from the link margin.
sentences.tts: 但零點六 F1 是零損耗的保守門檻，還可以用鏈路餘裕反推。

sentences.zh: 一條 1.2 公里、4700 MHz、餘裕 69 dB 的鏈路，障礙物剛好貼齊視線，只損失約 6 dB。
sentences.en: On a 1.2 km, 4700 MHz link with 69 dB of margin, an obstacle touching the line of sight costs only about 6 dB.
sentences.tts: 一條一點二公里、四千七百 MHz、餘裕六十九 dB 的鏈路，障礙物剛好貼齊視線，只損失約六 dB。

sentences.zh: 就算障礙物突出視線 12 公尺，也只吃掉約 25 dB，還剩 44 dB。
sentences.en: Even 12 m above the line, it eats only about 25 dB, leaving 44 dB.
sentences.tts: 就算障礙物突出視線十二公尺，也只吃掉約二十五 dB，還剩四十四 dB。

sentences.zh: 不過地形資料多半抓不到建物和樹，最可靠的還是現地會勘，親眼確認看得到對方。
sentences.en: But terrain data usually misses buildings and trees — a site survey, confirming you can see the far end, is still the most reliable check.

sentences.zh: 除了直射波，訊號也會經由地面或水面反射，走另一條路抵達。
sentences.en: Besides the direct wave, the signal also bounces off the ground or water and arrives by another path.

sentences.zh: 兩條路徑長度不同，到達時相位也不同，就會互相疊加或抵消。
sentences.en: The two paths differ in length, so they arrive with different phases and add up or cancel out.

sentences.zh: 路徑差約等於 2 乘 h1 乘 h2，除以距離。
sentences.en: The path difference is roughly 2 times h1 times h2, divided by the distance.
sentences.tts: 路徑差約等於二乘 h1 乘 h2，除以距離。

sentences.zh: 兩端天線都是 10 公尺高、相距 10 公里，路徑差只有 2 公分。
sentences.en: With both antennas 10 m high and 10 km apart, the difference is only 2 cm.
sentences.tts: 兩端天線都是十公尺高、相距十公里，路徑差只有兩公分。

sentences.zh: 可是這 2 公分，在 1350 MHz 只佔波長的 9%，在 5900 MHz 卻佔了 39%。
sentences.en: Yet those 2 cm are 9% of a wavelength at 1350 MHz, but 39% at 5900 MHz.
sentences.tts: 可是這兩公分，在一千三百五十 MHz 只佔波長的百分之九，在五千九百 MHz 卻佔了百分之三十九。

sentences.zh: 另外，低仰角的地面或水面反射，本身還會讓相位翻轉約 180 度。
sentences.en: On top of that, a low-angle reflection off ground or water flips the phase by about 180 degrees.
sentences.tts: 另外，低仰角的地面或水面反射，本身還會讓相位翻轉約一百八十度。

sentences.zh: 所以高頻對天線高度和地形的小變化更敏感，更容易掉進深度衰落。
sentences.en: So the high band is more sensitive to small changes in antenna height and terrain, and falls into deep fades more easily.

sentences.zh: 對策是：把天線架高，並避開貼近水面或平坦地面的路徑。
sentences.en: The remedy: mount antennas higher, and avoid paths that skim water or flat ground.

sentences.zh: 低頻電波比較容易繞過或穿過樹葉這類小障礙物。
sentences.en: Lower frequencies bend around and pass through small obstacles like foliage more easily.

sentences.zh: 高頻段在視距內幾乎像光一樣傳播，一被遮住，損耗就很明顯。
sentences.en: The high band travels almost like light — once it's blocked, the loss is significant.

sentences.zh: 那下雨呢？在 6 GHz 以下，雨衰通常不顯著，要到 10 GHz 以上才明顯。
sentences.en: What about rain? Below 6 GHz, rain fade is usually minor; it becomes significant above 10 GHz.
sentences.tts: 那下雨呢？在六 GHz 以下，雨衰通常不顯著，要到十 GHz 以上才明顯。

sentences.zh: 濕氣和霧，對頻段上緣可能有些微影響。
sentences.en: Humidity and fog may have a slight effect near the top of the band.

sentences.zh: 另外，視距路徑的損耗指數約為 2，非視距環境可能升到 4 到 5。
sentences.en: Also, the path-loss exponent is about 2 with line of sight, but can rise to 4 or 5 without it.
sentences.tts: 另外，視距路徑的損耗指數約為二，非視距環境可能升到四到五。

chapters.zh: 城市：非視距與屋頂鏈路

sentences.zh: 在城市裡，訊號常要繞過轉角、穿過牆面；在這種真正的非視距環境，低頻段比較吃得開。
sentences.en: In a city, signals must bend around corners and through walls; in true non-line-of-sight conditions, the low band holds up better.

sentences.zh: 但屋頂對屋頂、彼此看得到，只是周圍高樓很接近視線時，結果可能相反。
sentences.en: But rooftop to rooftop — with a clear view, but buildings close to the line — the result can flip.

sentences.zh: 同一條 20 公里鏈路，障礙物在視線下方 15 公尺時，低頻損失約 1 dB，高頻幾乎沒有。
sentences.en: On the same 20 km link, with an obstacle 15 m below the line, the low band loses about 1 dB; the high band almost nothing.
sentences.tts: 同一條二十公里鏈路，障礙物在視線下方十五公尺時，低頻損失約一 dB，高頻幾乎沒有。

sentences.zh: 在視線下方 5 公尺，低頻 4.2 dB，高頻 2.4 dB，還是高頻佔優勢。
sentences.en: At 5 m below, it's 4.2 dB versus 2.4 dB — the high band still wins.
sentences.tts: 在視線下方五公尺，低頻四點二 dB，高頻二點四 dB，還是高頻佔優勢。

sentences.zh: 可是一旦突出視線 5 公尺，低頻 7.9 dB，高頻 9.8 dB，低頻反而比較好。
sentences.en: But once it pokes 5 m above the line, it's 7.9 versus 9.8 dB — now the low band is better.
sentences.tts: 可是一旦突出視線五公尺，低頻七點九 dB，高頻九點八 dB，低頻反而比較好。

sentences.zh: 交叉點，就在障礙物剛好碰到視線的位置。
sentences.en: The crossover sits right where the obstacle touches the line of sight.

sentences.zh: 開闊平地、長距離：路徑損耗是主角，低頻段餘裕較大，打得較遠。
sentences.en: Open, flat, long range: path loss dominates, and the low band has more margin and reach.

sentences.zh: 森林或植被密集：低頻段的繞射和穿透能力比較好。
sentences.en: Dense forest or vegetation: the low band diffracts and penetrates better.

sentences.zh: 水面與沿岸：反射強，多路徑衰落隨頻率升高，優先用低頻，並把天線架高。
sentences.en: Over water and along the coast: strong reflections and fading that grows with frequency — prefer the low band and mount antennas high.

sentences.zh: 山區地形夾縫：高頻段菲涅爾區較窄，搭配高增益指向天線，反而容易找到淨空路徑。
sentences.en: Mountain gaps: the high band's thinner Fresnel zone, with a high-gain directional antenna, can actually find a clear path.

sentences.zh: 不過高增益天線波束窄，對準精度要求也更高。
sentences.en: But a high-gain antenna has a narrow beam, so it demands more precise alignment.

sentences.zh: 快速架設、對準條件不確定時：低頻段波束寬、對準容錯高，但需要的淨空高度較大。
sentences.en: Rapid setup with uncertain alignment: the low band's wide beam is forgiving, though it needs more clearance height.

sentences.zh: 整理一下：大多數情境，低頻段損耗低、繞射好，也比較寬容。
sentences.en: To sum up: in most situations the low band has lower loss, better diffraction, and more tolerance.

sentences.zh: 高頻段則在邊緣淨空、山區夾縫，或需要窄波束時，有機會勝出。
sentences.en: The high band can win with marginal clearance, in mountain gaps, or when you need a narrow beam.

sentences.zh: 這些是物理原理層級的通則，實際選頻還要考慮頻譜派配、干擾、傳輸量和裝備規格。
sentences.en: These are physics-level rules of thumb; real band choices also weigh spectrum assignment, interference, throughput and equipment specs.

sentences.zh: 最後，用鏈路預算工具算過，再到現地確認。
sentences.en: Finally, run the numbers in a link-budget tool, and confirm on site.

sentences.zh: 謝謝收看！
sentences.en: Thanks for watching!

characters.roleEn: Radio at each end of the link
characters.descZh: 架在桅桿上的電台與天線。這支影片裡的每一條鏈路，都從它發射、由它接收。
characters.descEn: A mast-mounted radio and antenna. Every link in the video starts and ends here.

characters.descZh: 包住直線路徑的橄欖球形區域。頻率越低越胖，被擋到就會產生繞射損耗。
characters.descEn: The football-shaped zone around the path. The lower the frequency, the fatter it gets; intrusions cause diffraction loss.

characters.descZh: 樹葉會吃掉訊號，而且會隨季節和含水量改變。高頻特別怕它。
characters.descEn: Leaves absorb signal, and the effect changes with season and moisture. The high band fears it most.

characters.descZh: 可能擋住路徑，也可能是屋頂鏈路的架設點。地形資料通常抓不到它。
characters.descEn: It can block a path, or host a rooftop link. Terrain databases usually miss it.

characters.descZh: 在 6 GHz 以下，它的影響通常不大；到 10 GHz 以上才真的麻煩。
characters.descEn: Below 6 GHz its effect is usually small; it only really matters above 10 GHz.
